name: project-review
description: Adversarial project reviews, read-only by default — codebase (consistency, structure, architecture, rules, over production and test code alike), one change against the rules the project wrote down, and docs — each a standalone lens that challenges the artifact against the project's own standards and returns a prioritized action list; the change lens applies its settled fixes when run with --fix; the codebase lens also writes a standalone Markdown report with Mermaid diagrams and numbered deepening proposals; plus a retrospective on one coding session that proposes improvements to the coding agent's environment
